description: This file declares the class USBMassStorageImplementation which implements USB mass storage device management and configuration interfaces, including device notifications, mounting, unmounting, and device info retrieval within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBMassStorageImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing USB mass storage and configuration interfaces, managing device notifications, mounting, and unmounting.

classes.name: USBDeviceNotification
classes.description: Inner class implementing notification callbacks for USB device plug-in and plug-out events.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatchable job for handling USB storage events asynchronously.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of USBMassStorageImplementation, optionally setting it.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB mass storage events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected USB storage devices.

methods.name: GetMountPoints
methods.description: Retrieves mount points for a specified device.

methods.name: GetPartitionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves partition information for a given mount path.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided service.
